semantic_quality_checks.evidence: Table 2 was manually reconstructed into 70 source-located MIC/MBC records across seven SAMPs and five bacterial targets.
Table 3 was manually reconstructed into 84 source-located stability MIC records across six SAMPs, two targets, and seven treatment conditions.

12 APD6/DBAASP sequence records preserve C-terminal amidation as sequence_modified_not_normalized; DBAASP figure-derived exact percentages remain source_conflict unless supported by source text/table.

layer_1_database_record_identity.rationale: APD6 and DBAASP sequences match primary Table 1; source methods report C-terminal amidation, so plain sequence strings are preserved with sequence_modified_not_normalized caution. Database exact figure-derived antibiofilm/toxicity values remain source_conflict unless primary text/table supports them.

layer_2_activity_toxicity_evidence.rationale: The prior parser gap was repaired by manual Table 2/3 reconstruction plus source-supported prose/caption safety and biofilm rows. Exact plot-bar values not present in text/tables were not fabricated.

layer_3_mechanism.rationale: Mechanism claims are source-located and bounded: membrane damage/permeability and DNA/stress readouts are direct where assays support them; transcriptome and biofilm are not promoted to single-target direct mechanisms.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary methods report C-terminal amidation for all SAMPs; final sequence fields preserve the table strings and explicit modification caution.
Figure-only or database-rounded exact percentages were not promoted without source text/table support.
Mechanism is multimodal and assay-bounded, not a solved single molecular target.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered the primary XML MIC/MBC and stability matrices; worker-4 preserved terminal-modification and figure-derived database cautions; worker-6 accepts the paper with explicit cautions and no open blocking rework.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local XML/PDF/DOCX text and captions support semiquantitative biofilm, cytotoxicity, and hemolysis conclusions, but exact per-bar numeric values in figure panels are not present as parser-supported text or tables. The review therefore preserves database exact/rounded figure-derived values as source_conflict instead of fabricating primary-source rows.
